app_tagline: Plan trips by chatting. Every recommendation is grounded in real travel knowledge.
status_unreachable_hint: The backend is not running. The frontend shell works without it.
scaffold_notice: Phase 0a scaffold — planning features are not built yet.

states.offline_body: This page stays open, but nothing new can load and nothing you change will be saved until you reconnect.
states.permission_denied_title: You don't have access to this page
states.permission_denied_body: This area is for administrators. Everything in your planner is still available.
states.retry_after: You can try again in {seconds} seconds.

pwa.offline_page_body: We can't reach Travel Planner from this device right now. Nothing has been lost — your trips are on the server, exactly as you left them.
pwa.offline_page_available_body: This page, and nothing else. Travel Planner does not store your trips on this device.
pwa.offline_page_unavailable_body: Opening or editing a trip, chatting with the planner, research, and booking. None of them will run in the background — reconnect and try again.
pwa.update_ready_body: Refresh to get the newest version of Travel Planner.

errors.account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact support.
errors.account_locked: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.ai_rate_limited: The planner is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.ai_response_invalid: The planner could not produce a usable answer. Please try again.
errors.ai_timeout: The planner took too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.ai_unavailable: The planner is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.email_not_verified: Please verify your email address before signing in.
errors.firebase_email_not_verified: Your Google account does not have a verified email address. Verify it with Google and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.identity_already_linked: That account is already connected to another Travel Planner account.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email, username, or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_firebase_token: We could not verify that sign-in. Please try again.
errors.invalid_oauth_state: That sign-in link is no longer valid. Please start again.
errors.invalid_token: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one and try again.
errors.last_sign_in_method: This is the only way to sign in to your account. Add another one first.
errors.not_found: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.provider_email_unavailable: That account has no verified email address we can use. Make one primary and verified, then try again.
errors.provider_link_required: An account already uses this email address. Sign in to it, then connect this provider.
errors.provider_unavailable: The sign-in provider is unavailable right now. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a while before trying again.
errors.validation_failed: Some details are not valid. Please check the highlighted fields.
errors.version_conflict: This was updated somewhere else. Refresh to see the latest version.
